say:1:1411414001:1.text: You startled me! How bad is it outside?
say:1:1411414001:1.source_cn: 刚刚可吓了我一跳！外头怎么样？

say:2:1411414002:0.text: There are no big issues, but we've temporarily stopped work for safety. You guys should pack it up as well.
say:2:1411414002:0.source_cn: 没什么大问题，安全起见，暂时先停工了，你们这边收拾下也...

say:3:1411414003:1.text: Stopping work just because of a few shakes? Come on, we've all been through worse.
say:3:1411414003:1.source_cn: 啊？停工？不至于吧，不就是地震吗，摇晃几下的事。

say:4:1411414004:1.text: We can't be careless. We respect the mine, and it'll take care of us. If an accident happens, it'll be on our heads. So, move it.
say:4:1411414004:1.source_cn: 别不当回事，采矿可容不得大意，万一有事故那就是大事，赶...

say:5:1411414005:1.text: Alright, alright. Stop making a big deal out of it. It's been rumbling for two days now. Something was bound to happen.
say:5:1411414005:1.source_cn: 好好好，知道知道。照我说啊，你就是太严肃了，这两天每天...

say:6:1411414006:1.text: That girl just said the same thing. You're all making a mountain out of a molehill.
say:6:1411414006:1.source_cn: 刚刚那个小姑娘也这么说，我看啊，你们就是小题大做。

say:7:1411414007:1.text: You know a good mine is always monitored. You people get worried too easily.
say:7:1411414007:1.source_cn: 停工两天就得了，好好的矿洞还总是要检查这个检查那个的——

say:8:1411414008:1.text: I have to talk to Hyla about this later. All the miners need to be re-trained...
say:8:1411414008:1.source_cn: 回头我得跟海拉说说，给矿工们的安全培训还得加强……

choice_prompt:10:1411414008.text: I have to talk to Hyla about this later. All the miners need to be re-trained...
choice_prompt:10:1411414008.source_cn: 回头我得跟海拉说说，给矿工们的安全培训还得加强……

say:11:1411414009:1.text: Oh, right, you guys were outside. Yeah, I've been hearing big rumbling sounds down here. Sometimes it's a loud pop.
say:11:1411414009:1.source_cn: 啊，对，外头没有吗？在这儿听得可清楚了，这几天老有轰！...
say:11:1411414009:1.male: Oh, right, you guys were outside. Yeah, I've been hearing big rumbling sounds down here. Sometimes it's a loud pop.
say:11:1411414009:1.female: Oh, right, you guys were outside. Yeah, I've been hearing big rumbling sounds down here. Sometimes it's a loud pop.

say:12:1411414011:1.text: Then I heard a loud noise, then shaking, and she ran off.
say:12:1411414011:1.source_cn: 就刚刚摇晃之前，我就听见轰隆一声，然后就开始摇，没多久...

say:13:1411414012:1.text: Said it was nothing and told me not to worry.
say:13:1411414012:1.source_cn: 我还想安慰她，结果她先安慰我，说没什么大事，让我别担心。

say:14:1411414013:1.text: She was as lively as they come. I've seen plenty of pointy-eared girls these days, but few of them were as friendly as her.
say:14:1411414013:1.source_cn: 是个挺活泼的小姑娘，我最近也时不时见那帮尖耳朵，可没几...

say:16:1411414014:1.source_cn: 刚刚那姑娘，是……萨洛克兰的人？

say:17:1411414015:0.text: Well, she ran up from below and then rushed back down. I'm guessing she must be.
say:17:1411414015:0.source_cn: 她从地下跑上来，刚刚又跑回去了，个子还挺高，耳朵也尖尖...

say:20:1411414017:1.text: We just observe. We do not judge.
say:20:1411414017:1.source_cn: 我们是观察者和评价者，不是判断者，巴赫朗。

say:21:1411414018:1.text: You already have an answer, Baelran. You ask us because you don't want to accept it.
say:21:1411414018:1.source_cn: 你的心里已经有结论了，只是因为你不想接受答案，所以才明...

say:22:1411414019:0.text: There are better people to ask than us.
say:22:1411414019:0.source_cn: 与其问我们，这里有着更适合询问的人。

say:24:1411414021:0.text: No matter what you want to hear, true or false...
say:24:1411414021:0.source_cn: 无论你想听到的，还是不想听到的，虚假的，还是真实的。

say:25:1411414022:1.text: As long as you ask Merlin, he will tell you.
say:25:1411414022:1.source_cn: 所有答案，只要询问梅林，<male>他</male><...
say:25:1411414022:1.male: As long as you ask Merlin, he will tell you.
say:25:1411414022:1.female: As long as you ask Merlin, she will tell you.

choice_prompt:26:1411414022.text: As long as you ask Merlin, he will tell you.
choice_prompt:26:1411414022.source_cn: 所有答案，只要询问梅林，<male>他</male><female>她</female>都会给予你。
choice_prompt:26:1411414022.male: As long as you ask Merlin, he will tell you.
choice_prompt:26:1411414022.female: As long as you ask Merlin, she will tell you.

say:27:1411414023:2.text: Alright, alright. I won't ask. But don't you think that girl is suspicious?
say:27:1411414023:2.source_cn: 好吧好吧，我就不明知故问了——各位，刚刚那个小姑娘很可疑。
say:27:1411414023:2.male: Alright, alright. I won't ask. But don't you think that girl is suspicious?
say:27:1411414023:2.female: Alright, alright. I won't ask. But don't you think that girl is suspicious?

say:28:1411414024:1.text: With those rumbling sounds, this whole thing feels... off. Like something bad is coming.
say:28:1411414024:1.source_cn: 还有下面的轰隆声，让我感到很危险。

say:29:1411414025:1.text: Let's catch up and look around.

say:31:1411414010:1.text: Some tall girl in a goth outfit. We were chatting before the quake.
say:31:1411414010:1.source_cn: 就刚才和我聊天的那个，个子挺高，穿得叮里咣啷的那个！
say:31:1411414010:1.male: Some tall girl in a goth outfit. We were chatting before the quake.
say:31:1411414010:1.female: Some tall girl in a goth outfit. We were chatting before the quake.
